title: ‘Yellowjackets’ Made Sophie Thatcher a Star. Then Things Got Weird
summary: Since that fateful plane crash on Showtime's hit survival drama, the 25-year-old actress has been making one left turn after another, playing killer fem-bots, getting kidnapped by Hugh Grant, and now starring in an inscrutable Danish sci-fi art film that earned her a 12-minute standing ovation. She must be doing something right.
